name: B10-0166/2024 (ECR) – EU actions against the Russian shadow fleets and ensuring a full enforcement of sanctions against Russia
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on EU actions against the Russian shadow fleets and ensuring a full enforcement of sanctions against Russia
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is setting out its opinion and asking the European Union and its member states to act harder against Russia's "shadow fleet" — old, often uninsured tankers that Russia uses to sell oil and get around sanctions. The Parliament wants tighter checks on these ships, a full ban on re-exported Russian refined oil, and action against the companies and countries helping Russia dodge the rules.

- The Parliament asks for stricter checks on shadow fleet tankers and proof of insurance; it affects ship owners, insurers and port authorities.
- It calls for a full ban on re-exported Russian refined oil and on new energy deals with Russia; this affects EU energy imports.
- It urges member states to act against companies and helpers enabling sanctions evasion; next, governments and the Commission decide whether to follow.
